title: Observability: dashboards + alerts for Suggestions (compute lag, API errors, UI funnel drop-offs)
creator: Allison Grant
description:
## Context
We’re shipping the Console “Optimization suggestions” beta (batching + caching only). We need production-grade observability for:
- Suggestions compute pipeline freshness/lag (so we don’t show stale or empty results without knowing)
- Suggestions API health (latency, 4xx/5xx, payload size)
- UI funnel health (impressions → expand → dismiss → apply-click), with non-paging alerts to catch regressions and telemetry outages

This ticket focuses on Grafana dashboards + alert rules wired to the existing telemetry/events.

Refs:
- Confluence spec: sources/confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/suggestions-beta-funnel-dashboard-spec.json
- Runbook: sources/confluence/eng-platform/runbooks/runbook-suggestions-api-latency-and-error-triage.json
- Events taxonomy: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/observability/suggestions-events-taxonomy.json
- API perf budget notes: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/platform-engineering/suggestions-api-performance-budget.json

## Scope
### 1) Dashboard: Suggestions API Health
Primary audience: on-call + service owners (Optimize/Console backend).
Panels:
- Request volume (RPS) by status class (2xx/4xx/5xx)
- Error rate: 5xx% (overall + by route: /optimize/suggestions)
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 (overall + by region)
- Top 4xx reasons (RBAC denied, invalid params) to separate expected from broken
- Payload size p95 (guardrail vs perf budget)
- Cache hit ratio (if enabled at gateway/service layer) + DB query time (if available)

Alerting (paging):
- API 5xx rate > 1.0% for 5m (critical)
- API 5xx rate > 0.3% for 10m (warning)
- API p95 latency > 450ms for 10m (warning) and > 800ms for 5m (critical)
- “No successful responses” (2xx=0) for 5m while request volume > 0.5 rps (critical)

Notes:
- Exclude known expected 403/404 from “error” panels; keep separate panel for authz denials.
- Link panels to triage runbook.

### 2) Dashboard: Suggestions Compute Freshness / Lag
Primary audience: Optimize pipeline owners + SRE during rollout.
Panels:
- Compute job runs: success/fail counts by hour
- Compute job duration p50/p95
- End-to-end freshness: now() - stale_as_of (surface the same staleness field the UI renders)
- Queue/backlog depth (if using scheduler/worker queue)
- Downstream dependency health: telemetry aggregate table lag / last watermark time

Alerting (paging):
- Freshness lag > 6h for 30m (warning)
- Freshness lag > 24h for 15m (critical)
- Compute job failure rate > 20% over last 1h (warning), > 50% over last 30m (critical)

Operational detail:
- Alerts should route to the same on-call rotation as the suggestions service (confirm in opsgenie/pagerduty config).
- Staleness alerts must be suppressed for orgs not enrolled in beta (avoid noise). Use a global job-level freshness metric rather than per-org.

### 3) Dashboard: Suggestions Beta Funnel (Product health / telemetry health)
Primary audience: Product + Eng (non-paging).
Panels:
- Funnel: impressions → expands → apply_click (rate + conversion)
- Dismiss rate over time
- Breakdowns by: org (top N), model, route, region
- “Telemetry coverage”: #eligible orgs with any impressions in last 24h

Alerting (non-paging, Slack only):
- Impressions drop > 70% compared to previous day (24h rolling) while API traffic unchanged (likely UI event emission regression)
- Expand rate drops > 50% WoW (flag potential UX regression / broken drawer)

Routing:
- Non-paging alerts to #optimize-suggestions-beta (or #console-observability) with a clear note: “FYI / investigate in business hours unless coupled with API health alerts.”

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Grafana dashboards created for: API Health, Compute Freshness, Funnel
- [x] Alert rules added with documented thresholds and rationale
- [x] Alerts routed correctly: paging for API/compute; Slack-only for funnel
- [x] Dashboards include links to the triage runbook
- [x] Verified with staged rollout data (dogfood orgs) that metrics are non-zero and dimensions look correct

## Implementation Notes / Metrics
Preferred metrics (names illustrative; align to actual emitted names):
- suggestions_api_requests_total{status,region}
- suggestions_api_latency_ms{quantile}
- suggestions_api_payload_bytes{quantile}
- suggestions_compute_last_success_timestamp
- suggestions_compute_freshness_seconds
- suggestions_compute_failures_total
- suggestions_ui_event_total{event_name}

If any required timeseries is missing, file follow-up tickets rather than blocking dashboard delivery.
